operations.name: cloudflare_list_zones
operations.description: List Cloudflare zones (domains) on the account, with their ids -- the zone id is what DNS operations need. Read-only.

operations.name: cloudflare_list_pages_projects
operations.description: List Cloudflare Pages projects on an account. Read-only.

operations.name: cloudflare_get_pages_project
operations.description: Read one Cloudflare Pages project, including its live subdomain and latest deployment. Read-only.

operations.name: cloudflare_list_web_analytics_sites
operations.description: List the Web Analytics (RUM) sites on an account, with the site_tag each one is identified by. Call this first: cloudflare_web_analytics needs a site_tag and there is nowhere else to get one. Read-only.

operations.name: cloudflare_web_analytics
operations.description: Real traffic for a site running Cloudflare Web Analytics: total pageviews and visits over a window, the top 20 paths, and the top 10 referrer hosts, in one call. Free and script-based, so it works on any host including Vercel -- the site needs the Web Analytics beacon in its HTML and a site_tag from cloudflare_list_web_analytics_sites. Roughly six months of data is kept and a window longer than 30 days is refused. Read-only.

query.default: query($accountTag: string!, $siteTag: string!, $since: Time!, $until: Time!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { totals: rumPageloadEventsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 1, filter: {siteTag: $siteTag, datetime_geq: $since, datetime_leq: $until}) { count sum { visits } } byPath: rumPageloadEventsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 20, orderBy: [count_DESC], filter: {siteTag: $siteTag, datetime_geq: $since, datetime_leq: $until}) { count sum { visits } dimensions { requestPath } } byReferer: rumPageloadEventsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10, orderBy: [count_DESC], filter: {siteTag: $siteTag, datetime_geq: $since, datetime_leq: $until}) { count dimensions { refererHost } } } } }
query.describe: GraphQL query. The default answers totals + top paths + top referrers; only override it to ask something else, and if you do, declare exactly the same four variables ($accountTag, $siteTag, $since, $until) because those are what this tool sends

since.describe: Start of the window, ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'. At most 30 days before `until`

until.describe: End of the window, ISO-8601 UTC

operations.name: cloudflare_create_dns_record
operations.description: Create a DNS record in a zone -- how a domain gets pointed at something that was just deployed. Only usable when a proposal listing this tool has been approved.

name.describe: Record name, e.g. 'www' or the full hostname

content.describe: Record value -- an IP for A, a hostname for CNAME
